{{short description|Russian mathematician (1929–2005}}
{{distinguish|text=the Russian mathematicians [[Alexandre Mikhailovich Vinogradov|Alexandre Vinogradov]] (of [[Vinogradov sequence]]) or [[Ivan Vinogradov]] (of [[Vinogradov's theorem]])}}
{{family name hatnote|Ivanovich|Vinogradov|lang=Eastern Slavic}}

'''Askold Ivanovich Vinogradov'''  ({{langx|ru|Аско́льд Ива́нович Виногра́дов}}; 1929 – 31 December 2005) was a [[Russians|Russian]] [[mathematician]] who worked in [[analytic number theory]]. The [[Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem]] is partially named after him.<ref>A.I. Vinogradov, The density hypothesis for Dirichlet L-series. Izv. Akad. Nauk SSSR Ser. Mat., 29 (1965), pages 903-934; Corrigendum. ibid. 30 (1966), pages 719-720. (Russian)</ref>
